priority_note: Current UI contract; overrides historical policy strings in content.json.

theme.switch: in-place; does not reset scroll or details
theme.no_script: relative native link to companion HTML

navbar: v6.1 repair preserved; transparent top, scoped blur on scroll, no white no-script plate

projects.title_and_main_area: Native primary link extended over card via a CSS pseudo-element; no hover navigation or card onclick.
projects.footer_layer: Separate z-index:2 layer above the primary link z-index:1.
projects.event_label: Native official competition link, sourced via competition_ref; subtle underline and keyboard focus.
projects.non_link_outcome_text: Rank, year, and prize are readable text; not an invisible repo link.
projects.prize: Kyara outcome line: US$30,000 prize. Same small size; no large badge, Hero claim, or total-pool display.
projects.award_scope: Competition-entry award, not owner net income.
projects.legacy_detail_field: Fallback copy for non-competition projects only; linked outcomes derive rank/year/URL from awards.
